name: seanlee10
description: Agent skills by Sean Lee: hwp-parser converts HWP/HWPX documents to Markdown; google-photo collects and curates photos and videos from Google Photos via the Picker API; kipris-search searches KIPRIS for Korean patents, utility models, trademarks and designs; email-draft drafts customer emails and copies them to the clipboard as Gmail-ready rich text; ga4-blog-report reports a blog's GA4 traffic per post, per source and from AI engines.

plugins.name: seanlee10-skills
plugins.description: Agent skills by Sean Lee, including hwp-parser (HWP/HWPX to Markdown), google-photo (collect and curate Google Photos via the Picker API), kipris-search (search KIPRIS for Korean patents, trademarks and designs), email-draft (customer emails as Gmail-ready rich text) and ga4-blog-report (GA4 blog traffic per post, source and AI engine).
